_comment: Maps what's on screen to an activity category. Edit freely -- this file
encodes YOUR apps, and is meant to be corrected whenever the log shows
IMPORTANT: browser needles match the WINDOW TITLE, which is the page
title -- not the URL. Brave shows 'Command Center - Notion', never
'notion.so'. Write brand names as they appear in a tab, not domains.

_notes.javaw: javaw.exe is the Minecraft Fabric instance, but is generic Java. If a Java tool is ever used for school, match it by window title instead.
_notes.youtube: 'video' is kept separate from 'anime' because YouTube is genuinely ambiguous -- lectures and leisure look identical. Split further if the log shows it mattering.
_notes.discord: Appears in both browser_rules and process_rules; the desktop app is the usual path.
